description: The sensorimotor network is the most extensive resting-state component, involving 27 percent of grey matter (Tomasi and Volkow 2011, as reported by Safron), which he reads as support for embodied self-models at the center of integration.
limitations: Reported secondhand in Safron 2019. The original study is not read here.

sources.quote: constituting the most extensive resting-state component involving 27% of overall grey matter (Tomasi and Volkow, 2011)
